intro: Hadoken Swiftstrider has a plan to break the impasse with the Woodpaw gnolls: strike down several of their leaders, who call themselves Alphas, in quick succession. Hadoken wants you to be the one to carry it out.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The plan is for various leaders of the gnolls - Alphas as they call themselves - to be taken down within rapid succession. If we're able to execute this sort of swift and precise devastation against them, it would cause chaos in their ranks. Perhaps it would also drive a message through their thick flea-bitten heads that we can and will destroy them!
I want you to be the messenger of my will; eliminate five of their Alphas within one hour for this to work friend, or we'll remain at this impasse!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Time is running out, friend! If you're not here to report that you've taken out the Alphas, then you're wasting time!

clips.title: Completion
paras: You've done as I have asked, and for that I salute you. Take this small reward as compensation for your efforts, friend.
With their numbers thinned and their leaders slain, the gnolls will think twice about storming the camp. This doesn't conclude the issue at hand, however...
There must be some reason why the gnolls have been whipped into such a frenzied state. Before they have a chance to regroup though, I want to find out what is causing it.
